sloka: अहम् अस्मिन् गिरौ दुर्गे बहु योजनम् आयते ।चिरात् निपतितो वृद्धः क्षीण प्राण पराक्रमः ॥४-५९-७॥
transliteration: aham asmin girau durge bahu yojanam āyate ।cirāt nipatito vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇa prāṇa parākramaḥ ॥4-59-7॥

translations.english: 'With my vitality and prowess depleted, I have been staying for a long time on this mountain, extended by several yojanas and inaccessible.
